Welcome to Cheeky Monkey
Your Surf and Yoga Camp in Midigama
GOOD TO KNOW: We’re renovating our rooms to make your next stay is even cheekier and comfier! 
While the rooms are getting their glow-up and aren’t bookable right now, our surf store is still open and ready for you!
Catch waves, not worries – welcome to Cheeky Monkey Surf Camp in Midigama, Sri Lanka.
Just a few barefoot steps from the best breaks on the south coast, we’re your laid-back base for surf, sun, and island vibes. Whether you’re a total beginner or chasing your next big ride, our experienced instructors will guide you through every step – with surf lessons tailored to your skill level, your pace, and your style.
We’re not just about riding waves — we’re about living the surf lifestyle. Wake up to salty air, chase tropical swells, chill with new friends, and soak up the local island culture. Our surf packages are flexible, affordable, and designed to give you the most epic experience, no matter your budget.

About us
Welcome to Cheeky Monkey Guesthouse, founded by Baba and proudly run by the Dodangoda family. Named after Baba, our Baba’s Surf Shop sits right alongside the guesthouse – together creating a space that’s all about surf, community, and the authentic spirit of Sri Lanka.
As one of the oldest guesthouses with a surf shop in Midigama, we’ve been sharing the stoke with travelers from all over the world for years. Staying with us means you’re not just a guest – you’re part of the family. Our tropical haven offers a laid-back, welcoming vibe where you can truly experience our beautiful country.
Whether you’re here to catch your first wave, improve your surf skills, or simply soak up the island vibes, we’ve got you covered. Join us for surf sessions, unwind with yoga, or just kick back with good company in our café.
At Cheeky Monkey, we love nothing more than welcoming new faces into our ever-growing family. Come as a stranger, leave as a friend – and take a piece of Sri Lanka’s surf culture with you.
